# FrontBuffer <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
FrontBuffer:Int32
```

**Returns:** The handle of the front buffer.

## Description

Returns the front buffer: the picture that is on the screen. [Flip](Flip) updates it from the back buffer.

## Differences

* The front buffer holds what the last Flip showed. [SaveBuffer](SaveBuffer) of it is the way to take a screenshot.
